# Save Formats by Title

**Evidence:** measured: generated from the save-container matrix, where every committed save fixture is classified from its bytes and round-tripped. Nothing here is game-verified.

Each row is one sample save. *Detected type* comes from the file's own content, never its folder name; *codec* is the container variant; *inner TDB* says whether a coherent database was found; *edit* whether a real field edit went through the editor and survived a reopen. See [Save Containers for Xbox 360 and PS3](Save-Containers-Xbox-360-and-PS3) and [Save Containers for PS4](Save-Containers-PS4).
